fixed.explanation: ArrowExtensionArray._str_extract raises when no named groups exist, and pc.extract_regex needs named groups. It also keys the result only by group names, so unnamed groups are dropped. The fix labels groups the same way as _get_group_names (the name, or the 0-based position). It also uses the Python regex fallback whenever any group is unnamed.

query.intent: The extractall/extract method of the Arrow-backed string extension array (ArrowExtensionArray / ArrowStringArray) builds a result DataFrame from regex capture groups. It must name columns for unnamed groups by their positional index (0, 1, ...) as the object-dtype implementation does, instead of failing or dropping them.
query.symptom: str.extract with unnamed regex capture groups on an Arrow-backed string Series raises an error or drops columns instead of labeling the columns by group position.
